subject: Your 2AM story is now part of our history
preview_text: You helped build something for 600+ heartbroken souls. See what your journey unlocked.
body_paragraphs: Remember that 3AM spiral when you opened Fresh Start for the first time? That moment of raw, messy honesty didn't just help you heal—it became a blueprint for every user after you. Your late-night check-ins, your mood swings, your small wins—they're the foundation of something bigger than any single breakup.

Here's the truth nobody tells you: Healing alone is a myth. Every time you tracked your no-contact streak or vented to the AI therapist, you were adding a brick to a wall that now protects 600+ others from crumbling at 2AM. Your struggle taught our system what real recovery looks like—not a straight line, but a jagged path forward.

We built a Legacy Mission inside the app. It's a hidden timeline showing exactly how your early days shaped the coping strategies that now cut average recovery time by 40%. You'll see your own anonymous data points alongside the collective journey of everyone who showed up when it hurt most.

Open Fresh Start now and find your Legacy Mission. It's waiting at the bottom of your mood tracker—a quiet archive of the night you chose yourself. P.S. The AI therapist has a message for you from the user who joined on Day 1. She's 70 days ahead now.
